aesthetics: Fine art, editorial, minimal luxury, high contrast (cream & graphite), award-worthy.

typography.notes: H1 should be massive but bound by fluid typography (`text-[8vw]`). Avoid generic bold weights for headings; use `font-medium` or `font-normal` with Playfair Display to maintain elegance.

colors.notes: No pure white or pure black. Use the off-white cream background consistently. Borders should be extremely subtle.

visual_enhancers.corners: rounded-2xl for main images, square for buttons/manifesto text blocks.
visual_enhancers.shadows: No heavy drop shadows. Keep it flat, brutalist, and editorial. Use 1px borders instead.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Buttons must have a 1px solid graphite border and transparent background, filling with graphite black and turning text white on hover. Images require a very slow, subtle zoom-in (`hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-[2000ms] ease-out`).

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use `py-24` to `py-32` between sections.
grids_and_layouts.masonry: Create an asymmetrical Tetris-like grid. E.g., combine `col-span-12 md:col-span-5` and `col-span-12 md:col-span-7` with massive gaps (`gap-16` or `gap-24`). Stagger the vertical alignments.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometric. Text should breathe. Center the hero, but left-align the manifesto and masonry content.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: MANDATORY: Use `@studio-freight/react-lenis` for premium momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: MANDATORY: Use `framer-motion` for a masked, line-by-line title reveal. Wrap lines in `overflow-hidden` and animate `y` from `100%` to `0%` with a custom cubic-bezier.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Apply a subtle parallax effect to the hero image using `framer-motion` `useScroll` and `useTransform`.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Use `react-fast-marquee`. Very slow speed, massive typography or uppercase small tracking font, separated by elegant bullet points.

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Minimalist sticky or fixed nav. Glassmorphism `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F8F6]/70` with a 1px delicate bottom border `border-black/5`. Logo centered, links distributed.

components.name: Kinetic Hero
components.description: Giant centered Playfair Display title. Below or behind the title, an 80vh image container `rounded-2xl` with a subtle parallax image inside. Dark overlay ONLY if text is directly over the image, but preferred is text above the image or overlapping cleanly.

components.name: Asymmetrical Masonry Grid
components.description: Product showcase. Images must vary in aspect ratio (portrait, landscape). Text underneath images with product names and abstract notes.

components.name: Numbered Manifesto Chapters
components.description: Editorial section. Large numbers (e.g., '01', '02') paired with elegant paragraphs. High negative space.

components.name: Editorial Marquee
components.description: Continuous scrolling ribbon. `react-fast-marquee`. Minimalist, low contrast text.

Perfume on top of an art book. Fine art editorial.
Minimalist bottle on stone with cork.
Perfume box and bottle on textured fabric.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the graphite text (#1A1A1A) on cream (#F9F8F6) passes APCA standards.
accessibility.motion: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for the Framer Motion reveals and Parallax.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links) MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="hero-cta"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React.js application with Tailwind CSS.
Use ONLY pure HTML/Tailwind for the layout structure. Do not wrap everything in Shadcn UI Cards; it restricts the editorial layout.
Set the global background in index.css to `#F9F8F6` and text to `#1A1A1A`.
For the hero reveal, map an array of words/lines inside a Framer Motion container with `overflow: hidden`, animating the `y` transform of the children.
The Masonry Grid must NOT be symmetrical. Use a standard grid but span items unevenly, e.g., `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12` where item 1 takes `col-span-5` and item 2 takes `col-span-7`.
Ensure image containers have `overflow-hidden` so the very slow hover scale (`hover:scale-105 duration-[2000ms]`) doesn't break the layout.
Translate all text into Portuguese as requested (e.g., 'Descubra a Essência', 'Capítulo 01').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures or noise overlays separate good from extraordinary.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
